verification.independent_answer: push(5): no return value, top=0, stack=[5]. push(8): no return, top=1, [5,8]. peek(): returns 8, top=1, unchanged. pop(): returns 8, top=0, [5]. push(2): no return, top=1, [5,2]. pop(): returns 2, top=0, [5].
